'''Falleen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region and home to the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] species. It had jungles, vast plains, and icy mountains.
{{Planet-stub}}

==History==
While the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] kept the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in suspense, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] claimed to be the infamous [[Unidentified Falleen Prince|''Lost Prince'']] who was kidnapped 20 years ago. The royal family of [[Falleen (planet)|Falleen]] consequently hired someone to verify the claims. The [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] was eventually exposed as an imposter and admitted under arrest, that he was the son of one of the prince's original kidnappers as well as that true prince [[Death/Legends|died]] years earlier.<ref name="Son">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Prodigal Son}}</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_Falleen.png|thumb|left|180px|Falleen during the Clone Wars]]
In the years following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Falleen experienced a boom in the construction of factories and manufacturing facilities, as corporations found it was less costly to maintain such facilities on remote planets.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Zurros]], who served as a double agent for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] until Falleen openly joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]], though it took a [[Fall of Falleen|land invasion]] and coercion of the [[Unidentified King of Falleen|Falleen King]] to complete it.

Later, during the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] established a bacteriological research outpost on the planet. When a highly-destructive flesh-eating bacterium got loose in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], Vader ordered his ships in orbit to [[Bombardment of Falleen|raze the laboratory]] and the city surrounding it in order to save the rest of the planet. Vader wiped out the bacterium, along with an entire city and over two hundred thousand Falleen, including the royal [[House Sizhran]].<ref name="Shadows">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref><ref name="The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> However, biological and chemical research for military purposes continued on the planet in other locations.

A [[Blockade of the Falleen system|blockade of Falleen]] was also established by the Empire at some point, much to the rage of the planet's kings.<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref> Decades later, Falleen, which never joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Battle of Falleen (Yuuzhan Vong War)|fell]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], shortly after the destruction of the [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] shipyards and [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]]. After the war's end, the planet remained unaligned and isolated.

In [[138 ABY]] the [[One Sith]] sent the ''[[Darklight]]'', an [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] to [[Bombing of Falleen|bombard]] the planet into submission. However the plan was foiled by the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] crew and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] who destroyed the cruiser.
